svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Research Intern, S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences, 2026 MAY – JUL: GPU-accelerated discrete Voronoi diagrams in Python and Taichi. Density-aware cut-offs, benchmarked against the Jump Flood Algorithm. Backend Software Developer Intern, LIMA · Defense Sector Organization, 2025 JUL – DEC: Java and Spring Boot backend serving 700+ personnel. Owned PostgreSQL schema, query tuning, and JWT multi-level access. Moderator, Google Developer Student Clubs · NIT Silchar, 2024 SEP → MAY '26: Ran technical workshops for 30+ students on software and systems. Also event management executive, Electra Society (2024–25). B.Tech, Electrical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Silchar, 2023 → 2027: CGPA 8.26 / 10. Authors problems, validators and checkers on Codeforces Polygon; drills advanced DS&A on CSES.
